chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Yaqoub ibn Yazeed, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Jarir al-Qummi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Hajj is obligatory upon the people of wealth (Al-Jiddah) every year.
ai.seo_question: Is Hajj obligatory every year for the wealthy in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi presents the view of annual Hajj obligation for those with 'Al-Jiddah' (excess wealth beyond necessities), a position notably held by the Shia scholar Al-Shaykh al-Mufid and others, distinguishing it from the more common 'once in a lifetime' obligation. It underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the continuous duty of the wealthy to perform pilgrimage, reflecting a broader theological stance on the perpetual nature of certain religious obligations for the capable.
